# Life/Mana consumption subsystem

- **Status:** ⚠️ Unverified
- **Mechanic tags:** sustain, cost

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Shipped in the engine; not yet verified in-game. Per-pool consumed/sec → net recovery + sustain. "Recently" = 4s. B spine shipped; C (steady-state life% solve) partial.

## Implementation (engine model)

`consumption.py::calculate_consumption` is a post-loop reader. Per pool it reads typed source stats `<pool>_consumed_{pct_current|pct_max|flat}_per_{sec|cast}` (+ `_per_attack_use`) and computes `per_sec = pct_current×current + pct_max×max + flat` for `_per_sec`; `_per_cast`/`_per_attack_use` bases are × the skill's base USE rate (`rates["any"]`/`rates["attack"]`, from `compute_skill_rates` sps — triggered casts NOT counted). `%-current` uses the UNRESERVED pool (`max − sealed_<pool>`); `%-max` uses raw Max. `consumed_recently_<pool> = per_sec × RECENTLY_WINDOW_S` (`=4.0`); `floored_consumed()` quantizes per-N-consumed procs down to whole `unit` multiples. Unsullied Blade: `mana_consume_external_blocked` zeroes other mana consume; `..._mystic` bypasses. Skill COST is passed in and reported/subtracted SEPARATELY (never added to consumed figures). NYI: proxy use events (Seething Spirit) flagged, not counted; per-use vs per-cast not distinguished.
